scope: Native Fortran interpolation and support, unchanged warm full-pressure domain and validated cold rows, both legacy and masked formats. No cold/high-pressure source extrapolation.
source: SCVH hydrogen and helium; additive volume and mixing entropy, native logT2.42 row with pressure coverage retained per cell

native_atmosphere_table.scope: Native values and derivatives for every newly supported cell, unchanged old queries, rejected outside-support corners, and the independent 1375 K/logg6.475 source excluded from interpolation.

limitations: Cell support preserves the source domain; it does not improve the underlying SCVH physical approximation.
The independent SCVH density/entropy interpolants give Maxwell-relation mismatch up to0.005314 in the added row.
Only nominal opacity integrated envelopes tested; low-opacity sensitivity remains outside the source domain.
Grains and H3+ line absorption remain absent from these gas columns.
